title: OverflowMenu configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.OverflowMenuAPI.Create, parsed. Every property is required, as the platform always sends them all: an omitted one is not defaulted and stays undefined at runtime. A default is the value an invalid one falls back to. Generated by scripts/docs-ai-generator/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

Position.description: Preferred placement of the menu relative to its trigger (GlobalEnum.FloatingPosition); auto picks the best fit.

Shape.description: Corner shape of the menu: SoftRounded (default), Rounded or Sharp.

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
